title: Live Workflow Redaction Evidence
assertions: live workflows may run curl, aws, or docker, but public artifacts must contain only redacted summary evidence
redacted summaries must not include endpoint URLs, AWS resource names, tokens, task definition ARNs, image URIs, or raw response bodies
public workflow evidence coverage must not need accepted gaps for live smoke or live deploy workflows

loop.observation: The remaining workflow evidence gaps were live smoke and deployment jobs that could not safely publish raw operator output.
loop.hypothesis: A redacted summary sidecar can prove execution shape without exporting private endpoint, token, or AWS topology values.
loop.execute: Verify each live workflow publishes a generated summary artifact through this tool and keep only safe GitHub metadata in that artifact.
loop.evaluate: The verifier fails on missing summary wiring, stale generated docs, or summary fields outside the redaction contract.
loop.retrospective: Live workflows can now participate in the evidence loop while keeping private runtime details outside the public repository.
